description: This file implements a React component called 'BookOverview' that displays detailed information about a specific book, including its title, author, genre, rating, and an image, as well as navigation and styling elements.

classes.name: BookOverview
classes.description: A React component that fetches and displays details of a specific book based on route parameters.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component state with an empty book object and binds event handlers.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Lifecycle method that triggers fetching of book data upon component mount.

methods.name: handleClickToGoBack
methods.description: Handles navigation back to the previous page.

methods.name: getBook
methods.description: Fetches book data from the server using the book ID from URL parameters and updates the component state.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the JSX for the book overview page, including images, titles, and details.
